1.title: Inside the Rushed Effort to Get Trump His New Air Force One
1.summary: A New York Times investigation found that President Trump’s push to speed delivery of the aircraft led to ballooning costs and trade-offs in safety features.

2.title: President Trump’s New Air Force One Poses Potential Security Risks
2.summary: Our investigative reporter Eric Lipton explains how earlier this month President Trump abruptly switched aircraft when leaving Turkey because of a credible threat that Iranian proxies were targeting a new Air Force One that had omitted key security modifications needed for a Qatari Boeing 747.

3.title: How a Housing Bill Trump Spurned Became Law
3.summary: Despite partisan differences, intraparty feuds and the president’s lack of interest, Congress delivered the first major housing bill in a generation.

4.title: India’s Education Minister Steps Down, Handing Win to Protesters
4.summary: With Dharmendra Pradhan offering his resignation, the student protest movement achieved a major victory against the government of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Strikes Abate, Even as Trump Considers Escalation
5.summary: U.S. forces did not announce new overnight attacks on southern Iran for the first time in about two weeks, but tensions remained high, with Saudi-led forces striking Houthi targets over the Red Sea.

6.title: Fires Rage in Spain and France, Forcing Thousands to Flee
6.summary: Firefighters were scrambling to contain blazes that were moving toward major cities. Some 200,000 people have evacuated or sheltered at home.
